title: Link aggregation with LACP
summary: Bundle two parallel links between two switches into one logical link using LACP.
objectives: Create a link aggregation group on both switches
Choose LACP modes that can negotiate
Add the member ports and confirm the bundle forms

tasks.title: Create the group with LACP
tasks.description: On both switches create Eth-Trunk 1 and set it to LACP. At least one side must be active: two passive sides wait for each other forever.
hints: The group is a logical interface of its own.
Example on each switch: system-view, then interface eth-trunk 1, then lacp mode active

tasks.title: Add the member ports
tasks.description: Add GE0/0/1 and GE0/0/2 to Eth-Trunk 1 on both switches.
hints: Members are added from the port, not from the group.
Example: interface GE0/0/1, then eth-trunk 1, then quit, and the same for GE0/0/2

criteria.label: SW1 Eth-Trunk 1 has two member ports
SW2 Eth-Trunk 1 has two member ports

tasks.title: Check that the bundle forms
tasks.description: Both cables must now be bundled into one logical link between the switches.
hints: Both sides need the same kind of group: LACP on one side and a static group on the other never bundle.
Two passive sides never bundle either.

criteria.label: Two links are bundled between SW1 and SW2
